source: 刘晓燕《四级你还在背单词吗》
title: The House of Wet Clay
tts_text: Umi lived in a small cottage at the edge of the rain forest. The air there was always humid, and in the tropics the heat was heavy. After the rain the ground stayed moist for days, and the sheets in her room were damp and heavy. Only the early morning brought a chill. In that house, water and clay were vital; without them she could not work. She worked hard to attain one small skill each week, and she was happy to obtain a bag of good clay. Water will not retain its shape, so she had to maintain the fire under the pot all day. A bowl of rice was enough to sustain her, and the forest seemed to pertain to a world she would never know. In the evening she would entertain visitors with tea and stories. Once, heavy rain detained her at the market until dark. Another time, a thief was arrested near her door. She made little figures of every species she saw in the forest. Each creature had its own shape, and she was a creative artist in her own quiet way. Her hands could give a concrete shape to soft clay. She believed every human being carried a story, and that humankind had always done the same. She was humble about her own work, and she never lost her humour when a figure broke. Each individual piece was different, and no two were ever the same. She would divide the clay into small balls, then subdivide one ball into four parts. The wet weather could damage a finished figure, and long rain would render the garden useless.

sentences_cn: 乌米住在雨林边上的一间小屋。
那里的空气总是潮湿，在热带，热气沉沉的。
雨后地面会一连几天都是湿的，她房里的被单又潮又重。
只有清晨才有一点凉意。
在那间屋子里，水和黏土至关重要；没有它们她就没法干活。
她每周努力学到一个小本领，能买到一袋好黏土她就很高兴。
水保不住形状，所以她得整天让锅下的火不灭。
一碗米饭就够她维持生活了，而那片森林仿佛属于一个她永远不会了解的世界。
傍晚她会给来客端上茶，讲讲故事，招待他们。
有一次大雨把她在集市上耽搁到天黑。
还有一次，一个贼在她门附近被逮捕了。
她给在森林里见到的每一个物种都做了小塑像。
每只生物都有自己的形状，而她自己就是一个安静的、有创造力的艺术家。
她的双手能给柔软的黏土一个具体的形状。
她相信每个人都带着一个故事，而人类一直和她做着同样的事。
她对自己的作品很谦逊，塑像碎了也从不忘幽默一下。
每一件单独的作品都不一样，从来没有两件是相同的。
她会把黏土分成小球，再把一个球细分成四份。
潮湿的天气会损害做好的塑像，长时间的雨会让园子变得一无用处。

words.cn: 至关重要的;必不可少的
words.mnemonic: 六个头的(vi是罗马数字六)， 说明这个人很有头脑，他的地位一定是“至关重 要的”。
words.zhenti: We will lose a vital part of what has made humanity as a whole so successful as a species. 我们将失去使人类作为一个整体取得 如此成功的一个重要部分。(2017)

words.family: vitality n. 活力 / vitamin n. 维生素

words.mnemonic: tain 词根，意思同 take(拿)，at 表示“一再地”。一再地拿着(当你特别喜欢一 个东西，最终得到的时候，一定日日拿着)→获 得，达到。
words.zhenti: We expect our pupils to do their best, and we give them every encouragement to attain this goal. 我们期望我们的学生尽他们最 大的努力，我们也会鼓励他们来实现这一目标。
words.sentence: She worked hard to attain one small skill
words.root: at(一再) + tain(拿) → 一直拿着 → 达到

words.mnemonic: re(重复)十tain(拿)，重复地拿 着，那“拿”这个动作是“保持”的→保持。
words.zhenti: Their babies retain the ability to produce their own chlorophyll. 它们的幼崽保留了自己 产生叶绿素的能力。(2019)
words.sentence: Water will not retain its shape
words.root: re(再) + tain(拿) → 拿着不放

words.mnemonic: main主要的，那“主要的全拿 (tain)着”是什么意思？你们的钱，主要的谁全 拿着？当然就是在家中主管钱的人一家之 主，他在“维持”一家人的生活。

words.cn: (尤指在自己家中)招待，款待；使快乐；娱乐

words.zhenti: Visiting a bookshop as curiosity leads us can be a good way to entertain ourselves. 好奇 心引导我们去书店是一种很好的娱乐方式。 (2017)

words.mnemonic: sus下，tain拿，从下面拿着。 女娲拿着补天石，她是怎样拿着补天石的？从 下面拿着→维持；承担，支撑。
words.zhenti: Some of those small mammals help to sustain such big birds as golden eagles. 有些小 型哺乳动物有助于饲养像金雕这样的大鸟类。 (2019)

words.root: per(每一) + tain(拿) → 都归它管 → 属于

words.mnemonic: ob表示方向，tain拿，朝着某个 方向拿着→获得，得到。

words.cn: 逮捕 n. 逮捕,拘留

words.mnemonic: 这个单词很像 special，世界上 每个“物种(species)”都很特别(special)。

words.family: specific adj. 具体的；特定的

words.zhenti: As one of the most brutal predators(食肉 动物), killer whales may not fit the image of a cultured creature. 作为最残忍的掠食者之一， 虎鲸可能不符合养殖生物的形象。(2019)

words.zhenti: Teachers should aim to build a supportive, creative environment for students to do this work.教师应该致力于为学生创造一个支持性 的、创造性的环境来完成这项工作。

words.zhenti: Researchers have come to realize that being humble generally indicates the presence of deeply admirable personal qualities. 研究人 员已经意识到，谦虚通常被认为是非常令人钦 佩的个人品质。(2021)

words.zhenti: The hot, humid air over the ocean causes severe tropical thunderstorms. 海洋上空炎热 潮湿的空气造成了严重的热带雷暴。

words.zhenti: Most of the world's fridges are to be found, not in the tropics where they might (070) prove useful, but in the wealthy countries. 世 界上大多数冰箱都不是在可能被证明有用的热 带地区，而是在富裕国家里。

words.derived: tropical /'tra:pıkl/ adj.热带的，湿 热的 例 Developing nations in tropical regions should do more to protect their rain forests. 热 带地区的发展中国家应该采取更多的措施来保 护他们的热带雨林。

words.cn: 冷的，令人紧张的 n. 寒冷，害怕，冷漠

words.sentence: Only the early morning brought a chill
words.root: 谐音「吃」+ ll(两根冰棍) → 心里发冷

words.mnemonic: mo想成汉字“毛”，ist 结尾表 示人，比如 scientist 科学家，那这个单词就是毛 人，浑身都长了毛，为什么？天气太“潮湿”了， 身上都长了毛。

words.sentence: long rain would render the garden useless
words.root: 联想：re(再) + nder(想成 under) → 使变成某种状态

words.cn: 潮湿的 n. 潮湿;挫败；沼气 v. (使)潮湿

words.zhenti: The sheets are damp with sweat. 床单被 汗水浸湿了。

words.cn: 损害，毁坏 n. 损害

words.zhenti: They claimed damages for their heavy losses. 他们要求赔偿他们的重大损失。(2021)

words.zhenti: We gave out a cheer when the red roof of the cottage came into view. 当小屋的红色屋顶 映入眼帘时，我们发出了一声欢呼。

words.cn: 单独的；个别的 n. 个人

words.cn: (使)分开，分散；分配；分享；分担n. 不同， 差异，分歧；分水岭

words.sentence: She would divide the clay into small balls

words.mnemonic: sub 表示“下面”；divide 是“分 离，分开”，该单词就是在下面分开。一个盗窃 团伙盗窃成功后已经分赃了一次，然后私下在 下面又分了一次，那就是“再分”。

words.root: sub(再往下) + divide(分) → 再分一次
